title: Chicago Union Station
visualBrief: Whole individual above-ground Chicago Union Station historic headhouse and physically attached mapped Canal Street arcade/canopy. Preserve the separate underground concourse east of Canal, independent modern offices, public roads and surrounding buildings. Author all four exterior fronts and the actual roof/service masses after resolving the roof layout; no invented extra station platforms, copied lettering, advertising, people, trains or navigable interiors.
nativeAxes: +X S toward Jackson Boulevard;-X N toward Adams Street;+Z W toward Clinton Street;-Z E toward Canal Street;+Y up.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: The connected passenger ensemble uses one standard host field datum outside its street facade. Exact threshold/platform grades remain approximate. Retained exact-Q way/203442440 identifies Q1155989. The long axis is N/S: signed +X south toward Jackson Boulevard; -X north toward Adams Street; +Z west toward Clinton; -Z east toward Canal Street. Current PMTiles supplies the whole main building35184575531272 with height26m and attached long Canal strip35184815348058,layer1. The two ordinary street photographs show the Canal lower pilaster/door front and Jackson round-column colonnade, heavy entablature/friezes, arched corner entries, corner clocks, upper repeated rectangular windows/pilasters, narrow attic windows and a stepped rooftop service block. They do not establish the complete hidden roof/courtyard inventory; resolve that with an ordinary roof picture or available map geometry before authoring. Retained8levels and current native26m envelope are source controls, not surveyed facade/tower levels. Two additional ordinary rooftop photographs were inspected: a segmental barrel-vaulted Great Hall skylight is recessed inside four surrounding office wings. Model roof court x+-35,z+-25 and glass x+-33,z+-15 are picture-scale interpretations; hidden services and exact measured dimensions remain unverified. Use estimated exterior parapet35.2m,penthouse39m,skylight eaves21.5m/crest28.5m; native26m remains a conflicting coarse map control. One unchanged outside Jackson/Canal street reference[66,-55],179.7933694m absolute,sets Y=0. No bespoke surveys or archival research.

Historic above-ground headhouse only. Four ordinary street/roof pictures and current standard PMTiles; exact-Q way identifies the whole block. Native height26m and8levels are coarse source facts; parapet35.2m,penthouse39m,glass eaves21.5m/crest28.5m,upper-floor levels and roof-court dimensions are explicit picture-scale estimates. Hidden north/west bays and rooftop services are interpreted,not surveyed. Independent underground concourse,modern offices,roads,rail platforms and urban furniture remain separate. No lettering,emblems,ads,people,vehicles or navigable interiors. Physical-device/dense-city timing and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured.
